result.quote: he entered the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense.
result.reason: The verse uniquely says that Uzziah trespassed by entering the temple with the purpose of burning incense. The key instead states that he actually burned incense, which the window does not establish. “Yahweh’s house” appropriately co-refers to “the temple of the LORD,” but the completed action should be revised to “He entered Yahweh’s house to burn incense.”
